lines.prompt: Determine whether a combinational path from n0 to n117[0] exists that does not traverse node n1816.

golden.reference: Yes. A combinational path from n0 to n117[0] exists that does not traverse node n1816.
golden.notes: Teams 2/3/4 (all full score) answer Yes, path avoiding n1816 exists. Team7 (also full score) instead states 'a path from n0 to n117[0] through n1816 does not exist' - a logically compatible fact that the grader accepted. Independently verified on the netlist: n117[0] IS reachable from n0, and n1816 is NOT in the transitive fanout of n0 at all, so both statements are true (every existing path avoids n1816). Golden answer for the literal question is YES such a path exists; a checker should also accept Team7-style phrasing asserting no path traverses n1816.
